stopPoints.label: Beautiful snowy mountains and forest
stopPoints.question:
Question (Weather): 'Look at the trees. Is it sunny ☀️ or snowing ❄️?'
Guidance: 'It's snowing! There is white snow on the trees.'

stopPoints.label: Poby and Harry are sleeping in bed
stopPoints.question:
Question (Yes/No): 'Are Poby and Harry sleeping?'
Options: 'A) Yes, they are. B) No, they aren't.'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'Yes, they are sleeping!'

stopPoints.label: Poby is waking up and stretching
stopPoints.question:
Question (Action): 'What is Poby doing now?'
Options: 'A) Sleeping B) Waking up'
Guidance: 'Good job! Poby is waking up and stretching his arms.'

stopPoints.label: Harry the little bird is upside down
stopPoints.question:
Question (Observation): 'Look at Harry! Is he standing up or upside down 🙃?'
Guidance: 'He is upside down! Silly little bird!'

stopPoints.label: Harry sits on top of Poby's head
stopPoints.question:
Question (Preposition): 'Where is Harry sitting?'
Options: 'A) On Poby's head B) Under the bed'
Guidance: 'That's right! Harry is sitting on top of Poby's head.'

stopPoints.label: Pororo and his friends gather in the snow
stopPoints.question:
Question (Counting): 'How many friends can you see standing in the snow?'
Guidance: 'Let's count together: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5! There are five friends.'

stopPoints.label: Eddy driving his small grey plane
stopPoints.question:
Question (Color & Object): 'What is Eddy driving?'
Options: 'A) A red car B) A grey plane ✈️'
Guidance: 'It's a grey plane! Eddy is a smart fox.'

stopPoints.label: Pororo and Crong get into the plane
stopPoints.question:
Question (Yes/No): 'Are Pororo and Crong ready to take off?'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'Yes, they are in the plane!'

stopPoints.label: The grey plane crashes into the ground
stopPoints.question:
Question (Outcome): 'Oh no! Did the plane fly high or did it crash💥?'
Guidance: 'The plane crashed! Poor Pororo and Crong.'

stopPoints.label: The plane gets stuck in a green pine tree
stopPoints.question:
Question (Location): 'Where is the plane stuck?'
Options: 'A) In a tree 🌲 B) In the water'
Guidance: 'It's stuck high up in the green pine tree!'

stopPoints.label: Pororo and Crong have bandages on their faces
stopPoints.question:
Question (Observation): 'What are on Pororo and Crong's faces?'
Guidance: 'They have white bandages 🩹 because they got a little hurt and dirty.'

stopPoints.label: Eddy shows a new big blue plane
stopPoints.question:
Question (Color): 'Look at the brand new plane! What color is it?'
Options: 'A) Yellow B) Blue 💙'
Guidance: 'Wonderful! It is a cool blue plane that looks like a bird!'

stopPoints.label: The friends look very surprised
stopPoints.question:
Question (Emotion): 'How do the friends feel when they see the new plane?'
Options: 'A) Angry B) Surprised 😮'
Guidance: 'They are very surprised! Their mouths are wide open!'

stopPoints.label: Pororo climbs onto the blue plane happily
stopPoints.question:
Question (Yes/No): 'Do they like the new blue plane?'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'Yes! They love it very much!'

stopPoints.label: Big bright fire shoots out from the rocket engine
stopPoints.question:
Question (Observation): 'What is coming out from the back of the plane?'
Options: 'A) Water B) Fire 🔥'
Guidance: 'Wow, it's bright yellow fire! It has a lot of power!'

stopPoints.label: The plane flies incredibly fast in the wind
stopPoints.question:
Question (Speed): 'Is the plane flying slow or super fast 💨?'
Guidance: 'It is flying super fast! Look at the big wind blowing!'

stopPoints.label: Snow and ice flying as they hit something
stopPoints.question:
Question (Object): 'Oh dear, did they hit a green tree or a white iceberg 🏔️?'
Guidance: 'They crashed straight into a big white iceberg!'

stopPoints.label: Pororo and Crong look a bit worried
stopPoints.question:
Question (Emotion): 'Are they laughing or do they look worried?'
Guidance: 'They look a bit worried 🥺 because they are about to fly again.'

stopPoints.label: The blue plane stands straight up on the track
stopPoints.question:
Question (Direction): 'Is the plane pointing horizontal or straight up ⬆️?'
Guidance: 'It's pointing straight up to the sky like a real rocket!'

stopPoints.label: The plane reaches outer space above Planet Earth
stopPoints.question:
Question (Location): 'Where is the blue plane flying now?'
Options: 'A) Under the snow B) In outer space 🚀'
Guidance: 'Amazing! They are flying high up in outer space! See the stars!'

stopPoints.label: Pororo and Crong spin around and feel dizzy
stopPoints.question:
Question (Feelings): 'How do they feel after bumping into something?'
Options: 'A) Hungry B) Dizzy 😵‍💫'
Guidance: 'They feel very dizzy! Their eyes are spinning round and round!'

stopPoints.label: A giant purple UFO flying in space
stopPoints.question:
Question (Color & Object): 'What did they crash into?'
Options: 'A) A purple UFO 🛸 B) A yellow bird'
Guidance: 'Correct! It is a giant purple UFO floating in space!'

stopPoints.label: The UFO falls down to Earth with grey smoke
stopPoints.question:
Question (Observation): 'Look at the sky. What is coming out of the mountain?'
Guidance: 'It's dark grey smoke! The UFO is falling down!'

stopPoints.label: The UFO is broken with electric sparks
stopPoints.question:
Question (Yes/No): 'Is the UFO working fine or is it broken?'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'It is broken! Look at the blue sparks!'

stopPoints.label: The friends hide behind forest trees in fear
stopPoints.question:
Question (Action): 'Why are the friends standing behind the big trees?'
Options: 'A) Playing hide and seek B) They are scared 😨'
Guidance: 'They are hiding because they are scared of the alien spaceship.'

stopPoints.label: Popo the blue alien friend appears
stopPoints.question:
Question (Color): 'What color is the alien friend Popo?'
Options: 'A) Blue 💙 B) Pink'
Guidance: 'Popo is blue! He has big round eyes and yellow legs!'

stopPoints.label: Pipi the purple alien friend waves her hand
stopPoints.question:
Question (Color): 'What color is Popo's friend Pipi?'
Options: 'A) Green B) Purple 💜'
Guidance: 'Pipi is purple! She is smiling and waving hello!'

stopPoints.label: Popo looks sad while Pipi looks happy
stopPoints.question:
Question (Emotion): 'Look at Popo on the left. Is he happy or sad 😢?'
Guidance: 'Popo is sad and crying, but Pipi is still happy!'

stopPoints.label: Loopy talks kindly to the alien friends
stopPoints.question:
Question (Action): 'What is the kind pink beaver Loopy doing?'
Guidance: 'She is inviting the new friends to come to her warm house!'

stopPoints.label: The cozy little wooden house at night
stopPoints.question:
Question (Time): 'Is it day ☀️ or night 🌙?'
Guidance: 'It's night time! The sky is dark blue and the house lights are on.'

stopPoints.label: Loopy holds a big plate of baked cookies
stopPoints.question:
Question (Food): 'Yum! What delicious snack did Loopy make?'
Options: 'A) Cookies 🍪 B) Ice cream'
Guidance: 'Perfect! She made a whole plate of yummy golden cookies!'

stopPoints.label: Popo holds a yellow star-shaped cookie
stopPoints.question:
Question (Shape): 'What shape is the cookie Popo is holding?'
Options: 'A) Circle B) Star ⭐'
Guidance: 'It's a beautiful star shape! Just like the stars in space!'

stopPoints.label: Popo and Pipi chew their cookies happily
stopPoints.question:
Question (Yes/No): 'Do the alien friends like the sweet cookies?'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'Yes, they like to eat the cookies!'

stopPoints.label: All the friends sit in a circle sharing food
stopPoints.question:
Question (Message): 'Are they fighting or sharing food together?'
Guidance: 'They are sharing food and eating happily! They are all good friends now!'
